summary: DAG store: no-op updates write nothing; wait_for_message stats the store, reads an unlocked snapshot only when it changed, and locks to claim only when a message is pending; 500 ms poll.

validation_result.old_code_idle: rewrote the store on every empty poll; 2.05 s CPU over 1.5 s

notes: Deviation (Occam): no nodes.json/inbox/heartbeat split. The measured cost was the locked rewrite+fsync per empty poll, which skipping no-op writes removes; heartbeat stays in the store and only triggers read-only rereads. Concurrency test uses 64 nodes (pairs) x 20 rounds instead of 256 threads to keep the suite ~12 s with one fsync per message op. Poll 250 -> 500 ms: 2000 waiters measured 0.28 core at 250 ms.
